stem_md: 设 $f(x,y)$ 是连续函数，交换二次积分 $\int_0^1dy\int_0^{y/2}f(x,y)dx+\int_1^2dy\int_{\sqrt{y-1}}^{y/2}f(x,y)dx$ 的积分次序[\quad]
search_text: 设 $f(x,y)$ 是连续函数，交换二次积分 $\int_0^1dy\int_0^{y/2}f(x,y)dx+\int_1^2dy\int_{\sqrt{y-1}}^{y/2}f(x,y)dx$ 的积分次序[\quad] $\int_0^1dx\int_{x^2+1}^{x+1}f(x,y)dy$ $\int_0^1dx\int_{2x}^{x^2+1}f(x,y)dy$ $\int_0^1dx\int_0^{x^2+1}f(x,y)dy$ $\int_0^1dx\int_{x^2+1}^{2x}f(x,y)dy$ 解答 原式=$\int_0^1dx\int_{2x}^{x^2+1}f(x,y)dy$。
